card.name: Partway through long medical terms
card.fires_on: Mid-word pieces of medical terms such as Du|oden|al, ret|in|opathy, le|pro|sy, and cerv|icitis. It also fires on a bracket right after 'Person Years' or 'patient-years'.

modes.label: Inside medical words
modes.description: Fires on the middle piece of a long clinical term that is split into parts.

modes.label: Bracket after exposure units
modes.description: Fires on an opening bracket following person-years or patient-years.
